message:
fix(dlss): stop native GPU work on failed recording, submit or fence wait

Prevent both renderer and presentation from reusing failed slots or waiting
on never-submitted fences. Propagate failure before upload, attachment
retirement and readback. Check prefix and continuation native begin/end.
Drain presentation before renderer destruction and distinguish lost-device
disposal from successful completion. Use one ALL_COMMANDS stage per waited
semaphore, covering presentation copies.

CPU tests include 112 injected native failure checks; no RTX acceptance claimed.
